scope: Independent review of latest multilingual help, additional features and in-app privacy text
source_review: Diagnostic sharing uses common l10n on every visible step and the existing native share bridge
Foreign additional-features screen exposes backup and diagnostics; schedule and sleep entries retain Korean guards
Merged alarm guidance uses common locale resources; manufacturer limitation and contact address are translated
Korean-only help sections and items are filtered before search; open Korean-only detail routes recheck locale
Menu labels in translated troubleshooting/backup guides match the current localized destinations
Manual sending, sender email and attachment storage text matches the reviewed code; no email-account access or automatic send introduced
limitations: No new APK/web build or full critical test suite
No new physical-device, mail-client or layout validation
In-app privacy copy consistency reviewed; external policy and Play disclosures not audited
Translations reviewed for meaning and consistency, not certified by native-language users
